ctx.x: Joe Marshall got to be the drummer with Arthur Godfrey.

Yeah, that's how I got it. Now this is a funny story, too, because when that happened, he and I met -- it was on a Christmas, and Joe had just left Arthur Godfrey, and I was hitting and missing, and we were both -- I was crying on his shoulder, and there's a funny thing about Joe -- he doesn't cry.
